Healing it right

How the piece heals is half the result. Follow this, and message the studio if anything looks off.

  1. First hours

    Keep the wrap on as long as Ali told you: 2 to 4 hours for film, or 3 to 5 days for second-skin. Hands off.

  2. Days 1 to 3

    Wash twice a day with lukewarm water and fragrance-free soap. Pat dry with a clean paper towel, then a thin layer of the cream from the studio.

  3. Days 4 to 14

    It will flake and itch. Don't pick or scratch. No sea, pool, sauna or direct sun until it's fully closed.

  4. Weeks 3 to 4

    The skin looks shiny while the deeper layers settle. Keep it moisturised and out of the sun.

  5. After a month

    Healed. Use SPF 50 whenever it's in the sun so the lines stay sharp. Book your free touch-up if a spot needs it.

Before you come in

How much does a tattoo cost?

It depends on size, detail and placement. The booking form gives you an estimate as you fill it in. Ali confirms the final price after seeing your idea and references, before anything is booked.

Why is there a deposit?

The deposit holds your time and covers the drawing Ali prepares for you. It comes off the final price. You can pay with Whish Money, OMT or in cash at the studio. If you cancel with less than 48 hours' notice, it's kept.

How long does a sleeve take?

A full black and grey sleeve usually takes several sessions, a few weeks apart so the skin can heal. Book a free consultation and Ali will plan the sessions with you.

How should I prepare?

Sleep well, eat a proper meal before you come, and drink water. No alcohol for 24 hours before. Wear clothes that give easy access to the placement.

Can I bring my own design?

Yes. Upload it with your request. Ali will adjust it so it fits your body and holds up well as it ages.

Is there an age limit?

You need to be 18 or older and bring a valid ID to your appointment.
